situation_block.label: Your situation
situation_block.body: Return date is ~30 days out; nothing is prepared: no freezer bank, no pump-space agreement, no childcare backup, no morning system; she oscillates between denial and 2am panic. She has no operating system for the transition, so week one back becomes supply crash + workplace embarrassment + evening meltdowns + guilt that eats her.
